title: Theme Preview Story

"use client"; import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"; import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/nextjs-vite"; import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react"; import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; /** * 🎯 Purpose: OKLCH theme preview and design token visualization * * This story visually presents the OKLCH color system used in the project. * - OKLCH (Oklab Lightness Chroma Hue): a perceptually uniform color space * - Wider gamut (P3) support allows more vivid colors * - Browser compatibility: 93% (100% with the PostCSS fallback) * - Supports switching between Light and Dark modes */ const meta = { title: "design/Theme Preview", tags: ["autodocs"], parameters: { layout: "padded", docs: { description: { component: "Full theme preview using the OKLCH color system. Shows every design token and examples applied to real components.", }, }, }, } satisfies Meta; export default meta; type Story = StoryObj; /** * 🎨 Full theme preview * * Visually displays every color token in the project. * Use the theme toggle at the top right to switch between Light and Dark modes. */ export const AllTokens: Story = { render: () => { const [theme, setTheme] = useState<"light" | "dark">("light"); // 🎯 Purpose: Apply the theme class to the actual element of the Storybook iframe // Manipulates document.documentElement instead of rendering / tags directly useEffect(() => { document.documentElement.className = theme === "dark" ? {/* OKLCH information */}
About the OKLCH Color System This project uses the OKLCH color space

Benefits

  • Perceptually uniform colors (more natural than HSL)
  • More vivid colors with wider gamut (P3) support
  • The default color format in Tailwind CSS v4
  • Consistent control of lightness and chroma

Browser Support

Chrome 111+, Firefox 113+, Safari 15.4+ (93%)
100% support for older browsers via the PostCSS fallback plugin

Format

oklch(lightness chroma hue)
e.g. oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815)
